question: What financing ratio, term, rate and down payment do licensed lessors (for example BIDV-SuMi Trust Leasing, Chailease, Vietcombank Leasing, Sacombank Leasing) offer for an imported food-extrusion line of USD 0.1 to 1.4 million, and will they do sale and leaseback on a chay maker's existing equipment?
why_it_matters: Decides whether leasing can carry the equipment part of a T1 line (ch08 section 8.7, T1 capital note).
cheapest_way_to_close: Phone three lessors with the T1 equipment list from t1_equipment_listings.csv and ask for an indicative term sheet.
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam Leasing Association; BIDV-SuMi Trust Leasing

question: Will a bank put a domestic textured-protein supplier into an anchor buyer's supply-chain finance programme (for example CJ Foods Vietnam or Vissan), and at what advance ratio, rate and payment term?
why_it_matters: This is the concrete form of the 'trade finance' in the T1 advice; without an anchor, T1's working capital (USD 0.6 to 3.5 million) has no named source.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the supply-chain finance desk of BIDV or Vietcombank with a named anchor and a draft supply contract.

question: Does an arrangement in which competing chay makers jointly buy soy flour or textured protein, or a chay makers' cooperative that buys for members, fall under the price-fixing ban in Articles 11(1) and 12(1) of the Law on Competition 2018?
why_it_matters: Section 26.7 suggests pooled offtake from two or three chay makers; the legal form decides whether that advice carries risk.
cheapest_way_to_close: Written opinion from a competition lawyer, or an informal query to the National Competition Commission.

question: Does a textured-protein plant that processes imported defatted soy flour qualify for Decree 57/2018/ND-CP Article 11 processing support, or its replacement, and how is the 1.5 times value test measured?
why_it_matters: Support of up to VND 15 billion would cover a large share of a T1 line's installed cost; the replacement draft would cut it to 30% of investment.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the Department of Finance or the Department of Agriculture and Environment in Ho Chi Minh City or Tay Ninh (former Long An).
owner_org_to_ask: Provincial Departments of Finance and of Agriculture and Environment; MAE

question: Is the SME Development Fund lending in 2026, at what rate and loan cap, and does a supplier to a chay value chain count as a value-chain borrower under Decree 45/2024/ND-CP?
why_it_matters: A named state lender that fits T1 better than venture money; current terms are unknown.
cheapest_way_to_close: Call the SME Development Fund or one of its partner banks.

question: What fees and priority sectors does the Ho Chi Minh City SME Credit Guarantee Fund apply under its May 2026 charter, and has it guaranteed any food-processing loan?
why_it_matters: A guaranteed loan could carry most of the installed cost of a T1 line in the city.
cheapest_way_to_close: Call the fund; read the full Decision 3204/QĐ-UBND.
owner_org_to_ask: Ho Chi Minh City SME Credit Guarantee Fund
